# Bot errors: status of every item in docs/rules-gaps.md

Status ledger for the bugs and rule faults listed in docs/rules-gaps.md. Last checked 08 Nov 2026 20:51 UTC on live v633 nova_b9994_rgsfix2 (flag values and code at each site, builder_queue.md, failure_chains.md, agent preregs in /data/zw4424/st/bNNN).

Owner column added 8 Nov (who acts next). Summary (204 rows): 25 FIXED, 8 BUILDING, 27 QUEUED, 26 CLOSED, 110 OPEN, 8 NOT A BUG.

Status words: FIXED vN = in the live source with its flag on. BUILDING = code in an unshipped bot, more reads planned. QUEUED = named on a queue line, not built (the 25 lifecycle rows are b1714's list; /data/zw4424/st/b1714 is empty so far). CLOSED = a fix was read and failed. OPEN = none of these, including items whose slot finished without building them (usually "0 fires": the firing read found the branch never changed a decision). NOT A BUG = rules-gaps says so, or the code/engine showed the item was wrong. "Where" is the live source (v633); file lines are approximate.

## Flee destination choice (v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder, cc Combat)
- 9 Nov ~17Z: FPB (FD1+FD2+FE1+FE2) FAILED shipcheck hard, BIG h2h .456, heavy turns +111/749. b1761 is running a leave-one-out. My suspects: FD1 walls (a body fleeing inside a zone has every first step walled, so it falls back to escape() and runs 2 searches), then FD2 (team retreats split). Use step costs rather than walls.
- **FD1 CONFIRMED: escape_toward never prices foe reach on its path.** move_escape.cc:448-465: goals = safe tiles within 6 no farther from the rally (Chebyshev); step_to_set (:462) walls = dynamic walls + avoid_bb, and avoid_bb is camp reach only (move_thin_holes.cc:563). Only the end tile is foe-safe; the path may cross a foe's reach. Called from combat_flee.cc:482, :500. This is the 01a1bfed Heart mechanism. b1761 9 Nov: the wall form (FPB bit 1, foe-zone tiles as walls) FAILED: a fleeing body starts inside the zone, so the first step is walled and step_to_set falls to escape(); FD1 alone .4860, all four bits .456 (shipcheck 10163), minus FD1 .5005 (1,000 maps). Fix needs a priced-escape form (foe reach as a step cost, EP9/priced_escape), not walls; spec asked of Combat. Fix: OR foe-zone inner tiles (reach-1) into the walls for this call, falling back to escape(); or price foe hits in EP9 and try priced_escape(goals) first. Firing: every retreat with a rally and a foe between.
- **FD2 CONFIRMED: two rally rules mix in one flee.** rally_ally (combat_flee.cc:59-75: frac > RALLY_MIN_FRAC, mate outside every zone) v react_rally (combat_team.cc:591-614: frac > .3, no zone test, skips only a mate with 2+ foes within 4, never checks retreating()). escape_toward uses react_rally, so a flee can run toward a mate standing inside a foe zone or itself retreating. Fix: escape_toward takes rally_ally(c.zones) (home if none); both skip retreating() mates.
- FD3 LIKELY: rally distance is Chebyshev, not walk (move_escape.cc:458, combat_team.cc:601, combat_flee.cc:84, combat_lethal_burst.cc:171); behind a wall the "nearer" mate can be far. Fix: mv::steps where fuel allows.
- FD4 LIKELY: the escape dash landing is not damage-checked (combat_fight_turn.cc:89, :100-112, :186-187).
- FD5 LIKELY: no partner-aware rally for C&I: RALLY_MIN_D 2 excludes an adjacent partner; CI_SAFE apart FLEE (champ_ci.cc:24-30) never steers to the partner. Design row with bot_errors C&I pair (line ~708).
- FD6 minor: lethal_burst_rally_tile (combat_lethal_burst.cc:153-170) has no foe-zone test.

## View-split consensus (v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Rule: views are not shared (GR:351); within a team, higher priority acts first and set_priority takes effect next round (GR:129-130); camps act at round start (GR:124), ties by priority (INT:100).
- **VS1 CONFIRMED: tie_prio mispredicts a not-yet-acted mate's priority.** move_turn_order.cc:93-97 replaces the mate's set value vn with base - 7*nearest_foe_acts_last_q(b->pos, b->gems), but an ally's gems are read only when a foe is near me and the mate within 8 (world.cc:445-451), else 0; the foe term uses my W.enemies. The decoded t0 (:96) is computed and unused. A carrying mate (q 1) is predicted q 0, off by 7, so camp-tie reads (move_camp_threat.cc:34/48, econ_camp_focus.cc:289, econ_tank_support.cc:203, econ_opening_walk.cc:12, champ_ci.cc:382, champ_ci_plan.cc:224) say the mate takes the hit when I do. Fix: take carrying from vn ((d/7)&1, no fuel), and with an unknowable foe term assume I take the tie. Firing guess 5-20 tie reads/g in crew clears.
- VS2 LIKELY: CWV tank choice (econ_approach.cc:252-266) counts unseen busy claimants in h.n but picks the tank from visible bodies only (.35 HP test for them, none for me) -> two tanks. Fix: rank CWV slots by P.tank_order; apply .35 to myself.
- VS3 LIKELY: vesper_open::keep (champ_vesper.cc:111-118) ends the stick on one member's own sighting and only removes itself from its local mask. Fix: also end when any crew slot stops claiming v (shared).

## Dead turns and spawn turns (v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
- **DT1 CONFIRMED: a dead body drops mates' news about the group it died at.** busy_with_group (econ_ward_intel.cc:21-25) = gi == T.target && (capturing || engaged || cheb(W.me.pos, anchor) <= 8). On dead turns perceive runs read_dead_turn (world.cc:308-322, :540-543), which never updates W.me.pos, and death_reset keeps T.target, so the test holds for all 60 dead rounds. Callers team_mem_apply_message (econ_comms_protocol.cc:110), the old read path (:312), intel_taken/intel_cleared (econ_observe.cc:346, :362, Prism :365) drop every cleared/timer/taken post about that group, and each code is decoded once (econ_comms_protocol.cc:170-171), so it is lost until I see the group. After respawn I re-rate a cleared/taken group as cheap and walk back to the foes that killed me. Rule: a dead body has only its ward's sight (GR:351, :375). Fix: `return W.alive && gi == T.target && (...)`. Not covered by RS2 (reads T.target directly). Firing guess .5-1.5 dropped posts/g, .1-.3/g harmful walks.
- DT2 LIKELY: the spawn heal hold (brain_turn.cc:503-508, errand_stage) runs before team_stage (converge :625, defend_mate :614-622, help_join :638); spawn_step (econ_opening_finish.cc:104-131) steps toward T.target, not the mate. A mate fighting 2 tiles off our spawn gets no help that round. Heal is full at turn end on any spawn tile (GR:153), so a step along spawn tiles toward the mate keeps the heal. Fix: in the hold, step along spawn toward converge/defend/HELP when set.

## Bushes and vision (v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Rules: from outside you cannot see into a bush or past it; in a bush you see the whole cluster, not into other bushes; the ward adds vision (GR:351-355); wards do not expire (GR:363).
- **BV1 CONFIRMED path: a flee blacklist is lifted on seeing the anchor tile alone.** observe_lift_stale_threat (econ_observe.cc:183-207): with no visible foe within 8 of the anchor and bbget(W.vis, anchor), it clears thr_round and restores fail_until. Unseen bush tiles near the anchor are not checked, so foes we fled from who stepped into a bush 3 tiles off the anchor are "proven gone" and the body re-takes the group into the ambush. Fix: also require (box 5 around anchor & M.bushes & ~W.vis) empty. Firing guess .3-1/g on bushy maps. **2026-11-09T17:35Z b1762: verified, fix costs score: rework.** As BB20 bit 1 the lift was blocked 387 observe-calls/g in 75% of games and the bundle read .4892 [.483,.495] h2h (shipcheck 10199, LOS 0%). Rework idea: lift after N rounds once the near bush tiles have been seen empty (memory), not only when they are lit now.
- **BV2 CONFIRMED path: recall_bush_threat counts bushes I can see.** combat_recall.cc:108-123 (read at econ_recall_heal.cc:259): any bush adjacent to a 1-2-round-old foe tile holds the recall, with no visibility test; a lit empty bush proves the foe absent. Fix: `bbget(M.bushes, q) && !bbget(W.vis, q)` as vanished_foe_last_tile does. Firing guess .1-.3/g.
- BV3 LIKELY: bush_watched (combat_fight_bush.cc:104-120; bush_perch_step combat_fight_turn.cc:464, :470) counts only foes and wards seen now; a foe seen stepping into the cluster 1-2 r ago and previously seen foe wards (permanent, GR:363) are ignored. Fix: add seen entries 1-2 r old on/next to the cluster; remember foe ward tiles until seen empty.
- BV4 LIKELY rare: tribute_restart_hold (econ_tribute_gates.cc:65-77) builds the escape list after ward::react without re-reading W.vis. Fix: perceive() when react returns true (as brain_turn.cc:752).
- BV5 design (Planner): bush_place skips any unlit bush within 6 of my ward (ward_bush.cc:94), which only drops OTHER clusters (lit tiles are already masked at :82). Interacts with ward churn row ~770.
- BV6 CONFIRMED, play-identical: world.h:64 comment says own_vis excludes the ward; it includes it (INT:177, world.cc:350).

## Camp model v rules (v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Rules: camps clear zero-timer buffs at turn start, act if awake, then tick buffs (GR:124); each camp hits its nearest champion (GR:192), ties by the priority in force (GR:129-130, INT:100); camp stuns are readable via sdk_camp_buffs, timer 1 after the cast (interactions.md:158).
- **CM1 CONFIRMED gap (sized 9 Nov by CI Analyser, 297 top-3 games: our Cassi camp stuns 13.5/g, victim a mate 10.2, mate acting after her 2.4, changed decisions <= ~.2/g; bundle line, not its own read; other stunners not counted): a pending camp stun is never read.** No sdk_camp_buffs call in the bot; VisCamp (world.h:47-52) has no stun; camp_threat_fill (move_camp_threat.cc:64-74) counts every awake attacker. A stunned golem my tank holds still prices its hit next round, so the tank bails / camp_out / leaves a capture for nothing. Fix: read the camp stun timer in perceive (visible camps), skip timer >= 1 in camp_threat_fill; also fixes the "two stunners pick the same camp" row. Firing: ~each camp stun cast before my turn while I am its target (few/g with a stunner).
- **CM2 CONFIRMED: my own camp-tie value ignores this turn's set priority.** tie_prio(P.my_slot) returns turn_order_base() (move_turn_order.cc:61-62) though set_dynamic_turn_priority (brain_turn.cc:268-295, :776) sets 40 / 35 / issac_order (partner + 1, champ_ci_plan.cc:214-226) before moves; toh_on_val (:55) is declared and never used. Issac sets himself to take ties but his own camp_threat says Cassi takes them. Fix: after the set, tie_prio(my_slot) returns the value set (toh_on_val). Pairs with VS1.
- CM3 LIKELY rare: hold_capture_slow (brain_capture.cc:233) prices camp_threat x (k-1), missing the hit at now+k after the payout (captures before camp turns, GR:124); camp_hits_before_capture_pay (econ_idle.cc:678-694) counts k. A kill then destroys the reward (GR:375). Fix: x k.
- CM4 LIKELY rare: Heart landing stun credit (combat_cast.cc:226-231, :247-250) sums stunned camps not in camp_threat(L). Fix: credit only camps counted at L.
- CM5 LIKELY minor: threat_kill_dps hits_me (econ_ward_intel.cc:331-334) ignores foes nearer the camp, ties, and uses W.me.pos not the tile. Fix: use the camp_threat nearest/tie test.

## Camp kills (owner question, v651, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder / Combat)
Rule: killer gets the bag + 100 gold; a camp kill destroys the bag and pays nobody (GR:375-381, :442); camps act at round start (GR:124); each camp hits its nearest champion (GR:192). The bot does not model camp kills on either side.
- **CK1 CONFIRMED path: camp-doomed foes still count as our kill.** finish_low (combat_assess_rules.cc:418-447), team_focus prize (combat_team.cc:494) and assess_carrier_cut gain (combat_assess_stance.cc:149) never test whether an awake camp targeting the foe kills it at round start; the helper camp_hit_strength_on_body(b, ours=false) (combat_team.cc:208) has no caller with false. A 25% foe next to an awake elk it is nearest to: we walk in, the elk kills it first, no gold, bag gone. Fix: when the foe cannot die this turn and camp_hit_strength_on_body(e, false) >= eff_hp(e), skip it in finish_low and zero its prize in team_focus / carrier_cut. Guess .05-.2/g.
- **CK2 CONFIRMED dead code: focus_under_other_heavy_camp (combat_assess_rules.cc:507-528) computes hit and returns false**, so the AvoidCampReach walk-in guard (combat_fight_actions.cc:310) never fires and the camp_threats_near(9) loop + kill_window cost fuel. Looks like a baked flag-0 leftover (no deadstrip record). Fix: delete the body (fuel, play-identical); `return hit` would be a separate behaviour read.
- CK3 LIKELY, bundle line (Combat: cheap; count fights within 2 of an awake camp in the calibration read): fight power drains our side by camp hits (combat_assess_power.cc:431, :448) but foes only get CAMP_BUSY_W .6 when within 1 of any awake camp (:339-341), targeted or not. Fix: drain foes by camp_hit_strength_on_body(e, false).
- CK4 = Combat's DNY (sized .036/g strict gate, 3 real denials/196 g, false 0/7; owner-requested passenger, gate with the Builder): a doomed carrier (no surviving tile, bag >= ~30) never prefers a camp death (destroys the bag) over a foe death (foe gets bag + 100). combat_fight_turn.cc:71, :126, :503-504. Guess .01-.05/g. Design (Combat).
- CK5 no spec (Combat 9 Nov: rarer than DNY): woken camps killing foe carriers are never valued as denial (combat_camps.cc:95-147). Needs a spec + count.

## Tribute denial and locks (v653, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Rule: a foe lock cancels a tribute (GR:226, :240, :275; INT:118-119); a foe can lock from 3, 5 with a ready dash (INT:30); a lock needs no sight (INT:122); between my turns only the foe paired with my place gets 2 turns (INT:20-22); a stunned body loses its next turn (INT:35).
- **TD1 CONFIRMED: a winning tribute start checks foe locks only for Marcella.** channel_safe_check<STUN> (combat_recall.cc:63-72) calls rgf_foe_lock_within only in the `immune` branch; stunnable carriers are blocked only by foe_stun_landing_round. Reached from winning_tribute_start_blocked (champ_prism.cc:502-510) and winning_bag_flipflop_clear. A Vesper (no stun) carrying a lock 5 tiles away: start counted safe, she dashes and locks, the winning channel is cancelled. Also the early outs nearest_known_enemy() > WSG_R 6 (:504) / > TG_R 4 (:517) ignore channel length. Fix: in the STUN branch also refuse when !rgf_crystal_chan && rgf_foe_lock_within(e, dist, fs); gate the early outs on dist - 5 > ticks. Rare, game-losing.
- **TD2 CONFIRMED: deny ranking gives mates my turn count.** game_deny_mates_ahead / game_deny_can_cancel_channel (combat_deny.cc:222-280) apply my L to every mate; a mate that already acted this round or has a pending stun has one turn fewer before the foe's turn start. Two such mates rank ahead, I stand down (GD_BODIES 2), the game-ending tribute lands. Fix: Lm = L - acted - stunned; false when Lm < 1. Rare, game-losing.
- TD3 LIKELY: a remembered game-ending channel out of sight (foe in a bush next to the altar; 11/124 maps) is walked to within 2 of the channeler's tile but never locked blind (combat_deny.cc:296, :687; deny_tribute_slow / game_deny_pick need a visible ST_TRIBUTE foe). Fix: within 2 of the altar with gd_mem live and a lock carried, place_lock blind; walk to the altar's 2-ring.
- TD4 LIKELY (probe first): a channeler adjacent to two altars gets the lock on the first-listed (combat_deny.cc:89-104, :444); the API cannot tell which altar it tributes at. 15/124 maps. Fix: prefer a stun; skip an altar our lock already blocks.
- TD5 CONFIRMED, ~0/g: foe lock-break time max(0, walk-1) + hits + tc (champ_prism.cc:580) is one turn long (last hit + submit share a turn, INT:121, p94). Fix: max(max(0, walk-1), hits-1) + tc.

## Failed-move fall-throughs (v653/v655, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder, BB22)
Pattern (FLZ family): a stage decides, its move fails, a later stage acts against the decision.
- **MF1 CONFIRMED: a FIGHT turn whose walk-in fails falls through to farming** (combat_fight_actions.cc:315 path_failed after step_to(focus, range, 20); combat_fight_turn.cc:489 returns false). On FIGHT turns lg_guard covers only lethal zones, so the farm walk can enter any non-lethal foe's reach; the hold branch (:491) returns true for exactly that reason, the failed walk does not. Fix: on path_failed && !acted, step_greedy toward the focus or hold, return true. Guess .5-2/g on hole/corridor maps.
- MF2 CONFIRMED 9 Nov (hysteresis intent combat_assess_stance.cc:245-247: 'own action'; fires 16.3/g, b1777; fix keeps W.moved; bug bar) (extends FE6): fight() stamps last_fight_round (combat_fight_turn.cc:~441) before acting, also when it then returns false, so next turn's hysteresis holds a fight that never happened. Fix: stamp only when acted || moved || hold.
- MF3 LIKELY, game-losing rare: game_deny_walk_steps (combat_deny.cc:152-177) judges reach with blocked() only, but the deny walk (step_to_set :476, :312, :702) runs inside lg_guard, which walls lethal zones (incl. from the channeler itself); the walk fails every turn and the game-ending tribute lands. Fix: lift avoid_on for game_deny / deny_memory walks when `ending`.
- MF4 LIKELY: altar_hold_turn (econ_altar_hold.cc:280-282) returns true even when step_field fails -> the body freezes (FLEE: no flee; CALM: no farm) every turn. Fix: return cheb <= 2 || W.moved.
- MF5 LIKELY = design (T.capturing covers the walk by intent, econ_capture.cc:551-553; 2.88/g; behaviour lane): capture walk failure (econ_capture.cc:726-735) keeps capture() true for up to 8 turns with busy_capturing on (react_guard, camp escape, probe off) and no foe hits. Fix: hit foes in range; drop after 2 failed turns.
- MF6 LIKELY: zone crew forces its target (contest_play.cc:707) before walk_to_S, whose step_to(S, 0, 40) has no greedy fallback (:378-380); on failure the farm walks to the entry alone. Fix: step_greedy fallback, return true.
- MF7 LIKELY rare: Prism carrier ping-pong (econ_bank_walk.cc:156, :173): with the mate adjacent, step_to returns false and go_home runs. Fix: cheb <= 1 counts as joined, hold.
- MF8 LIKELY: abort_ring_bank_walk (brain_turn.cc:~108) runs before ring_escape, which can fail (fuel, search 20): 40 r without banking. Fix: abort only if the escape moved.
- Dead code: brain_turn.cc:617 `else if (pg_walk && step_to(...))` never runs.

## Recall spin and channels (v655/v656, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Core spin mechanics clean: every action cancels the spin first, our tribute/crystal cancel it, one start + one cancel per turn (GR:118).
- **SP1 CONFIRMED: spin_on_turn_end (brain_modes.cc:172-189) starts a spin on every live off-spawn turn**, though start_recall can keep it only via recall_safe / carry_recall_gate, which refuse when hurt last round (econ_recall_heal.cc:240, :325), an awake attacking camp is within reach + 1 (:268-272, :326-331) or a recall was cancelled < 3 r ago (:266). A camp hit cancels it anyway (GR:275, :387). So spins on hurt / in-camp-reach turns are always wasted: a recall call + next-turn read, likely most farming turns. Fix: return at :183 when S.hurt == now(), attacking camp within reach + 1, or recall_cancel within 1. CAVEAT: not strictly play-identical — foes see ST_RECALL on us and may react; read on the bug bar, not as a pure fuel line.
- SP2 LIKELY ~.01/g: pending_spin_becomes_recall (fuel_meters.h:209-216, econ_opening_finish.cc:144) keeps a spin the engine dropped during a fuel cut (FXR bit 1 off): body stands thinking it recalled, then a logged cancel blocks recalls 3 r. Fix: keep only if round_number_nc() == W.round and the engine still shows ST_RECALL.
- SP3 LIKELY rare (errs safe): altar_hold_pinned(true) (econ_altar_hold.cc:311) and bag_too_late_to_bank_slow (econ_bank_decide.cc:183) use recall_rounds(home, false) = 5 while a kept spin takes 4 (econ_bank_win.cc:371 uses csx_recall_t()). Fix: pass sps_pending.
- SP4 ~0/g: Tavi shop (econ_shop.cc:41-43) cancels the spin before a can_buy read. Same class as econ_locks.cc:56 (RGE bit 128) / CN3. [QUEUED 12 Nov: same fix bundle]

A doomed Varg/Heart carrier reads safe. Fix: shield term min(shield, dmg/span * max(1, shield_turns)).

- SH5 LIKELY (partly design): low-HP bars ignore our own shield (combat_assess_stance.cc:120 LOW_HP .3; brain_low_hp.cc:167-170).
- SH6 LIKELY (errs cautious): remembered foe shields kept up to 15 r (econ_rate.cc:189-205) / seen ehp 4 r (combat_team.cc:391). Fix: zero after shield_turns + 1.

## Turn priority (v656/v657, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder)
Rule: a dead body still takes its turn and keeps its place by priority (GR:131, INT:17); priority then draft order, lower id wins ties (GR:129, INT:16); one body at a time interleaved (INT:14).
- **TP1 CONFIRMED: my own rank counts only visible living mates** (brain_capture.cc:186-191 foe_acted_before_me; combat_assess_contact.cc:274-279 build_acting_order_table -> foe_turns_within_rounds :324, :326). Dead mates (in nobody's vision) and unseen mates are left out; dead_turn (brain_turn.cc:66-67) resets a dead body to base P.prio (15-20), above any living mate near a foe, so ra reads low by one per dead mate. Unsafe direction: a foe's extra turn is missed in channel_safe_check / rgf_foe_lock_in_time. Fix: for 'acted this round' use the foe's completed-turn state bit (e.state & 32); for our order add dead/unseen slots from P.prio / last published value. Guess 5-20 miscounts/g, 1-3 unsafe. Distinct from M1 (EdRanks).
- TP2 LIKELY (cautious): stun_takes_next_turn (combat_lethal_burst.cc:94) = stunned && turns <= 1; a stunned foe with 2 counted turns really has 1 (INT:35-36), so recalls/delivers are refused near it. Fix: turns = max(0, nn - 1) for stunned foes.
- TP3 LIKELY: channel turns return (brain_turn.cc:736) before set_dynamic_turn_priority (:778): a fled-then-recalling body keeps priority 40 for 5 turns, takes camp ties first and its recall breaks (GR:387, INT:100); mates' tie_prio assumes it recomputes. Fix: reset to turn_order_base in the hold path when cur_prio >= 35 and camp_threat > 0.
- TP4 LIKELY rare: walk_cast_end (brain_modes.cc:108, :144-145) assumes priority 38 makes me first; a visible mate at 40 makes me second. Fix: skip when a visible mate's next priority >= 38.
- TP5 cleanup: hp_order_tier result never read (move_turn_order.cc:6-14, :34, :42; FTR_TAB[2]); stale comments :32, :89 (q is 0..25).

## Siege / heavy re-audit (v660, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder, design choice Planner)
Rule: a camp hits its nearest champion every turn until out of range; range Chebyshev (GR:186-192, :204; interactions.md:102); Jungle x.7 / Durability x.9 cut camp damage (interactions.md:70-71).
- **HV1 CONFIRMED inconsistency: the clear estimate's per-member HP budget (econ_team_model.cc:146: hp - CAL_TAB[10]% x maxhp, /camp_mult) ignores the exit cost the bail tests charge** (econ_tank_support.cc:402, :829, :1052: bail when eff < inc x (steps + 1.5) + .08 maxhp, steps = reach - d + 1, move_escape.cc:5-10). Exit is fixed by the camp: monolith 200 x 6.5 = 1,300, golem 120 x 5.5 = 660. A 1,500-HP body next to a monolith is budgeted 1,170 but bails at ~1,420 (holds ~80). Golem pair at 1,200: estimate 1,685 v real ~799. Estimate says feasible, execution bails -> may explain idle rows beside living heavy groups (rules-gaps:351) and OGT +1.1 deaths. Fix (Planner picks): subtract g.str_max x (reach_max + .5) x camp_mult per member in estimate(); or price exit at 1 step when a healthy relief is adjacent.
- **HV2 CONFIRMED: crew_bail::rounds / skip / crew_mates_in_reach (econ_tank_support.cc:1046, :1073, :248) sum raw c.str, while incoming_at / camp_threat apply ct_k (move_camp_threat.cc:156)**: a Jungle+Durability holder (126 per monolith hit) is priced at 200, rounds read ~37% short, bails early. Fix: x mu::my_camp(IN) / per-mate rule.
- HV3 LIKELY: tank/holder bail relief (econ_tank_support.cc:409-411, :839-841) needs only a melee mate > 50% HP, not above its own bail line; the relief bails next turn, nobody holds. Fix: relief needs crew_bail::rounds(...) >= 1.
- HV4 LIKELY: siege_slot_is_free (econ_team_ops.cc:250-257) passes unseen slots without the SG_HP 50% test; a recalling 30% mate counts, never comes, op collapses (60 r block, 25 r no calls). Fix: use modelled HP / last-seen recall state.
- HV5 LIKELY rare: about_to_capture (econ_idle.cc:746) tests within 4 of g.anchor (strongest camp), not of any member tile (capture = any spawn tile, GR:194, :198): a hurt body by the last kill recalls instead. Fix: nearest member tile within 3.
- HV6 mismatch: healer counted in siege K tests (econ_team_ops.cc:281, :294, :507-517, :781) v SG_K comment 'healer not counted' (common_flags.h:458). Decide which.
- HV1/HV6 Planner decision 9 Nov: execution = form (b) (exit ~1 step with an adjacent relief above its own bail line) + HV3, bug bar; estimate subtracts (n-1) one-step costs + one full exit (behaviour bit); form (a) contrast arm only. HV6: healer not counted toward SG_K (own bit). Rule check OK: camp hits its nearest champion each turn (GR:192), ties by priority (INT:100).

- **WG2 CONFIRMED same root: bank walk td_guard.active reads false under eo_guard or lg** (econ_bank_walk.cc:361, :407, :412, :428; brain_turn.cc:543): bank_safe_altar_walk skipped, bank_hole_dash allowed, the hold-outside-reach-with-bag branch does not fire. Fix: on() at all reads.

- WG5 LIKELY minor: escape_exit_field (move_escape.cc:13-31) and move_step.cc:316-334 fields leave avoid_bb out, so they fail instead of detouring under lg. Fix: OR avoid_bb into walls (clear my tile).

Each start/keep pair crosses the SAME line with no gap, so a foe stepping 1-2 tiles flips it:
- **PS1 CONFIRMED (13/32): hurt winning Prism (HP < 60%)**: start falls through to `nearest_known_enemy() > PC_CHAN_R` (8) (champ_prism.cc:605-607) when winning_channel_doomed is true; keep cancels at a known foe within 8 (champ_prism.cc:644-648, via brain_turn.cc:193). 00dunes__b r889-895 (bag 808, 33% HP, foe 9/8/9/7). Candidate: a 2-tile gap (keep cancels only within PC_CHAN_R - 2, or start needs > PC_CHAN_R + 2). Overlap WCR (owner-approved, wcr1 INCONCLUSIVE).
- **PS2 CONFIRMED (10/32): non-winning 30+ bag, same line** (:607 start v :644-648 keep). 00the-line__a r489-499. Same gap fix.
- **PS3 CONFIRMED (>= 6/32): nearest_known_enemy includes nearest_foe_distance_seen(PC_KNOWN_AGE 3) = last-seen distance minus age** (champ_prism.cc:484; combat_recall.cc:142): a foe seen at 9 that leaves vision reads 8, 7... at keep turns even if it walked away. Candidate: don't shrink a sighting whose last tile is in vision and empty; cap shrink at real walk.
- PS4 CONFIRMED mechanism (9/32): healthy winning Prism: start_refuse (econ_bank_win.cc:369) and keep_cancel (:362) run the identical foe_damage_over_ticks_deliver(3, WCK_TURNS 2) >= 100% eff HP test, no gap, no memory; inputs drift (cooldown window, stun next-turn, hidden foe -> mem() with DD1's +2); every foe gets 2 turns though only the pair-slot foe does (INT:22-24). 03fan__a r772-787. Candidates: start margin (foes 2 nearer / WCK_TURNS + 1); no restart at the same altar within N rounds of a keep_cancel; fix mem() per DD1.
- PS5: many channel ENDS are foe stuns (46 of 79 300+-gem ends) and foe locks, not our cancels (TD1 territory). Mates' deny place_lock (combat_deny.cc:136) does not check a channelling ally (rare).

## Kill tests (v668/v669, 9 Nov, Rule Checker; owner Builder; suggested flag KTB, one bit each)
Core one-turn sum (my_burst_allowances, kill_dmg) matches the rules (one cast, ranged walk+hit blocked, walk+reset+hit, FULL modifiers, shield holds through our turn). Problems are reach/edge tests and call sites:
- **KTB1 CONFIRMED: spell_alone_kills returns false for every ranged kit** (combat_burst.cc:109-114), so a ranged area kill at range + radius 5 (Stellar/Prism, GR:576, :606) is never a kill for kill_now / focus_still_killable / finish / lb_zones, though my_burst counts it and fight() can cast it. Fix: drop `k.ranged ||`. Step 0: assess_pick_focus turns with ranged, area ready, d == aoe_range + aoe_radius, eff_hp <= aoe dmg, kills(...,0) false.
- **KTB2 CONFIRMED: after the first hit kills a C&I focus, the reset goes on its dead partner** (combat_fight_actions.cc:340-345): fight_weakest_in has no alive check, the partner died with the focus (GR:442), attack_champion gets rc 42, reset wasted 8 turns. Fix: require the next target alive and not the focus's linked partner (or use weakest_other_foe_in_reach). Step 0: count at :342 alive == 0 && n is the focus's partner.
- **KTB4 CONFIRMED: hit-back uses kills(KQ_RAW)** (combat_assess_rules.cc:42): no reach gate or dash-landing test, and the raw 'kill' overrides the no-chase spawn drop and the low-HP/bag bars; misses spell-alone and ranged walk+reset kills. Fix: kills(e, d, 0). Step 0: count kills(RAW) != kills(0) by direction.
- KTB8 CONFIRMED: lb_zones skips a killable C&I body but keeps its partner's zone (combat_burst_reach.cc:194; sibling handles it at combat_lethal_burst.cc:143-150). Fix: also skip when a visible partner passes kills(..., 0).
- KTB16 CONFIRMED: Heart landing (combat_cast.cc:260) and Varg no-wake (:682/:699) price champion kills with camp_damage_factor (Monster, no Skirmish) into spell_kills_in_area. Fix: -k.dash_mod at :260; str x passive_mult at :682.
- KTB32 CONFIRMED: pair spell-kill picker skips every spawn foe (champ_ci.cc:412) though lethal damage on spawn kills (INT:97), and ranks by e.gems not both C&I bags (GR:381). Fix: skip_unkillable_foe_on_spawn; rank by hunt_prize.
- KTB64 CONFIRMED: Vesper dash kill counted with no landing test (combat_burst.cc:173 v champ_vesper.cc:23-25 VV_LANDING_CROWD). Fix: require dash_landing_tile and crowd test.
- KTB128 CONFIRMED: kills(...,0) first term and kills_ranged_knr ignore ren_layer::kills_me (combat_burst.cc:196), while attack_champion refuses that hit (combat_cast.cc:659). Fix: false when kills_me unless a spell alone kills.
- LIKELY: melee d = range + 1 kill with no free step tile; fight_stun redirects a counted stun-only kill; react_kite's free_cast may spend the needed spell elsewhere; unreachable() / team_focus reach omit the area radius (pairs with KTB1); my_next_hit_reach (= RC1).

## Pass 3 X20 unseen-foe extrapolation (v687, 07:07Z 10 Nov; owner Builder (pending route))
Rule bound: over T turns a foe closes T-1 walk steps plus its final reach:
- melee walk+dash+basic 4; ranged dash+basic 5 (INT:27);
- a walk-compatible stun at range 4 (GR:458) gives 5, which matters for channels, since a stun cancels them;
- the area stun excludes walking (GR:506) but still reaches range 4 + radius 1;
- +1 for the paired turn (INT:20-22).
(The hunter's GR:504-506 'walk-compatible' claim is wrong; the bound still holds.)
- **BUS1 CONFIRMED**: channel_safe_check remembered loop (combat_recall.cc:83-104) skips sightings aged 5-8 (BUS_SIGHTING_ROUNDS 4, while seen keeps 8) and floors reach at 4 (:8-9), 1-3 tiles optimistic. Users: channel_safe at econ_bank_win.cc:238/:430, champ_prism.cc:508 (Prism tribute start: owner-gated, build non-Prism), combat_fight_turn.cc:295. Fix: cap age at OBS_FORGET_ROUNDS, reach >= 5 (+2 dash+spell kit), dist = cheb - age - w - 1.
- **RLS1 CONFIRMED**: a seen foe that started a recall (s->rec, combat_memory.cc:208) is extrapolated from its old tile, never its spawn landing (GR:108, :275). Fix: d = min(old - age, spawn dist - max(0, age-1)). Sibling of IRC1 (intel copy).
- **SAG1 CONFIRMED**: sight_read stamps a mate's sighting with the read round t, not t - age (intel.cc:833 age computed, unused; :858-863). Fix: pass age in; r = t - age.

## Owner question: Ren retaliation in our fight maths (v697, 14:20Z 10 Nov; Rule Checker read)
- Covered: every champion hit goes through attack_champion (combat_cast.cc:666 ren_layer::kills_me) and every cast through cast_via_sdk (:61 ren_retaliation_of_cast, sums every visible Ren the cast hits: single target, Prism slot 0 cc 1.5xF, area radius, dash landing; stun-only/heal/shield 0). Prism has no own attack path. Retaliation = 0.2 x Ren Focus x his Skirmish/Collectors (mu::mo) v my hp + shield / Durability (mu::ehp): matches GR:752, INT:167. Independent of Ren's HP, so the killing blow is refused too ('retaliates as he dies'). Both wrappers refresh_self, so a second hit in a turn sees the first retaliation. Focus picks also skip a lethal Ren (combat_team.cc:154, combat_fight_turn.cc:38/:149, combat_flee.cc:129/:338). Our own Ren: body_dps adds 0.5 retaliations a turn for any body with the passive (combat_dps.cc:93), both sides.
- Known gaps: Varg splash alt hit without kills_me (row 103); TC7 flee_shot reset; the guard is per hit and doesn't reserve HP for foes acting before my next turn (fight assessment, not the passive).
- NEW REN1 POSSIBLE rare: ren_retaliation_of_cast sums W.enemies only, so a Ren hidden in a bush inside an area spell's radius retaliates unpriced. Fix: count unseen-foe tiles of the radius as a possible Ren when a foe Ren is drafted.
- NEW REN2 minor (cautious): the reset second hit tests kills_me_twice after attack_via_sdk's refresh_self already took the first retaliation (combat_cast.cc:739, :705), so it reserves three retaliations; use kills_me there.

## Ren rows from b1824's RBG report (build_b1824_rbg.md), relayed by CI; Rule Checker checked on v702 16:43Z 10 Nov; owner Builder
- **RRT1 CONFIRMED (model error; behaviour lane: changes every Ren fight read)**: body_dps (combat_dps.cc:93-94) adds OUR Ren's retaliation as 0.2xF x H x DPS_REN_HITS_A_TURN (0.5, :29, 'assumed when the PASS count is off'), independent of how many foes can hit him. Rule: 0.2 x Focus to the attacker on EVERY direct hit (champions and camps, while stunned and as he dies; GR:752, INT:167). Focused by 2-3 foes he takes 2-6 hits a turn (resets, double turns), so his side is under-priced exactly when focused and over-priced when nothing reaches him. Fix: expected hits = sum over foes whose one-turn reach covers him of their hits per turn (1 basic, +1 with a ready reset, +1 per damaging cast), x 0.2 x his Focus x mu::mo(him); 0 when none. Matters for RBG bit 32 (aggressive stunner).
- **TCW1 CONFIRMED (correctness; read flat on the testbed)**: tank_cast_before_walk (econ_tank_support.cc:539-550) gates on caster_spell_reaches (combat_calm.cc:308-326), which returns false unless is_caster_champion() and only checks slot_dmg/slot_aoe, so Ren (melee; slot 0 is a cc-with-damage stun that excludes walking, INT:27) walks first and loses the stun that turn. E.g. melee dasher, dash cd 2, d 6, k 4: counted 0 damage, really hits on its turns 3 and 4: the body holds the capture under uncounted damage. Fix: subtract 2 tiles per dash for dash kits. May be a deliberate bound.
- Known not refiled: foe_first_hit_turn counts cooldown c ready on turn max(1, c) not c+1 (rules-gaps:71, cautious).
- Clean: deny stun timing, foe_stun_landing_round, rgf_foe_lock_within, foe_two_turn_damage, foe_damage_over_turns, horizon_fit/heal_of, our dash routes, crystal_escape_fields, splash_through_mate, prestep_blocked, long-span rates.

## HPL1 (CI Analyser, exact puppet of 01a1c63b-5134-7626, condor-work/reports/analysts/ogr2_diag_1110.md; Rule Checker checked v702 17:08Z 10 Nov; owner Builder)
- **HPL1 CONFIRMED (rule error; firing likely common: any partly visible group)**: observe_count_group (econ_observe.cc:85-105) adds every HIDDEN member at its static full HP (cb.hp); both writers then overwrite memory: the visible-alive branch (:200-206, m.hp_left = hp) and the engine-alive branch (:249-257, 'hidden members counted at full health'). There is NO per-member last-seen HP (cb.hp is the static max). So a group's remembered HP RISES when a hit member leaves sight, though camps never regenerate (INT:106) and only a respawn restores HP (GR:202). Trace: Ryth's hp_left for group 0 2,547 (r45) -> 4,800 (r46) while Vesper read 1,362; Issac's crew of 2 then infeasible (3,025 v budget 1,030), rate_for no_crew (econ_rate.cc:156-157) r48, walked 19 tiles away, foe captured r71. Fix: never raise hp_left without a respawn: hp_left = min(previous hp_left, visible sum + full for hidden) when the group has not respawned since (prev status ALIVE, respawn_at not passed); reset to full only via mark_respawn/new life. 54 hp_left reads elsewhere use it as current HP (lower is the safe direction for none). Play-changing (crew feasibility, clear estimates, target choice): Step 0 count of 'hp_left raised without respawn' first, then behaviour lane or bug bar by firing. Related: HPS1 (ward view keeps old hp_left).

## BSB rules check (Deep spec_bsb_1110.md; Builder asked; Rule Checker 17:53Z 10 Nov)
- **Per TILE, not per group.** A tribute needs only a body within Chebyshev 1 of the altar (GR:226); what stops a body standing on a tribute tile is a LIVING camp occupying it (a live camp is a unit; dead camp tiles pass, INT:135, and capture requires standing on dead members' spawn tiles, GR:196). Probe evidence: probe_1110/p72.out arm C0, 'r2 step true': our body WALKED onto a dead member's tile (15,16) while the other member (15,15) still lived. No rule ties a tile to its group's other members. So a gated altar's tribute tile opens once that tile's own camp is dead; our gate_open (econ_travel_gates.cc:261), bankable (econ_value.cc:48) and bank_gate_walk (econ_bank_walk.cc:257-276) wait for the whole group: too strict (a missed bank route, not illegal play). Deep's GR:161/:226 citations don't state it; the right basis is GR:196 + INT:135 + the p72 probe.
- **Bit 2 cost (gate siege, tank bail econ_tank_support.cc:401) on the tile camp alone is NOT the full rules cost**: one hit wakes the whole cardinal group (INT:105), so the group's other members within their reach of the tile (and of the path) attack while we kill the tile camp and while we stand there for the tribute (several turns, GR:226-233; damage doesn't cancel a tribute, GR:275, but can kill). Price = tile camp kill + awake members whose reach covers the tile/path over the kill + walk + tribute turns; tile-camp-only is right only when no other member reaches.

- Origin: b706 RC_LOOP bit 4 (1 Nov): stops full-HP bodies recalling from the same spot with nothing gained (often crystal trips): refuses the third such recall when all three start within 4 tiles, gems unchanged, nothing bought/cancelled; the 150 rounds run from the FIRST recall (release at first + 151) (econ_recall_heal.cc:324-361, econ.h:356-358); 150 likely mirrors RCL_SC_SKIP/RHL_SKIP.

## Prism Improver turn-order claim (spec_par_1110.md 'The rule this uses'; Rule Checker 18:28Z 10 Nov): CORRECT
- Measured basis (engine 3.0.0 sandbox, probe_1106/p33.out, p34.out; INT:9-22): interleave by priority, starting team first, start team alternates, a priority written in R takes effect in R+1 for both teams, surplus bodies act last, a dead body keeps its place. In p33 A4 is A's rank 0 from r4 (prio 100): r5 (A starts) order A4 B6 A1 B8 A2 B5 A0 B9 A3 B7; r6 (B starts) B8 A4 B5 ...: between A4@r5 and A4@r6 every foe acts once in r5 and B8 (B's r6 rank 0) acts again before A4 = 2 turns (claim a); between A4@r6 and A4@r7 (A starts, A4 first) each foe acts at most once, B8 none (claim b). p34 (4 v 3, C&I adjacent ids) shows the same pattern for A's rank-0 body 1.
- Caveats: (a) exactly ONE foe gets 2: the foe that is its team's rank 0 in the next round (any foe can become it by writing priority this round); (b) holds with unequal counts (surplus foes act after the interleave, never before X when we start), dead foe bodies (they hold a place, their turn is harmless), stunned foes (lose turns, never gain). Precondition: X strictly highest among OUR bodies every round: X's value must beat our own override bands (40 lethal-next-turn, 35 finish-first, Issac's camp-tie order), else a mate writing 40 > X breaks it; a mate at 40 v X at 45 is fine.

- b1828 shop/item/rate rows checked (Rule Checker, v707, 2026-11-10T18:48:18Z):
  - RPB1 CONFIRMED (econ_items.cc:865). The shop puts shards on the first unfinished entry of a type (econ_shop.cc:28-31, need[] occurrence test). The emblem_rank window (:687-697) lists unfinished entries, but counts[t] > 0 freezes every unfinished entry of that type. Fix: in the window loop, record the entry whose need[si] == emblems owned + 1 and freeze only that one. Bugbar is OK; it changes play when a type is repeated in the window.
  - GGD1 CONFIRMED (econ_items.cc:1002/:1026, greed_gate). have = counts[shard] for every unfinished entry. In shop(), a later entry is reached only after the earlier one completes, and the re-read counts give have 0 there. So g is over-projected, and a second Greed of a part-bought Greed type skips the have == 0 gate. Fix: have only when need[si] == emblems owned + 1, else 0.
  - PGS1 CONFIRMED, rare (econ_items.cc:1052, passive_first). The skip tests per type (counts of shards or emblem > 0), so every Greed entry of a stat with one Greed owned or part-bought is skipped, and passives are never moved ahead of a second Greed of that stat (750 gold, GR:299). Fix: test per occurrence (need[si] > emblems owned and the entry is not the part-bought one).
  - DSR1 is NOT a rule error (econ_rate_crew.cc:291). 8 is not the recall time: GR:274 gives 5 ticks, 3 with Home. It is a pricing margin for leaving a dash-only group (same value as RECALL_TRAVEL); walk groups get no exit term, so it can't be swapped for recall_rounds. The only rule-tied part is that it ignores Home (3 ticks), so Home holders are over-charged 2 rounds. Optional: t += 8 - (5 - rs::recall_rounds(home, false)). Behaviour/param lane, not bugbar.

- Owner Q: is map symmetry handled correctly for horizontal and vertical maps? (2026-11-10T21:43:49Z) CORRECT. The bot reads the engine's symmetry (cambc::map::symmetry(), SDK: horizontal = x reversed, vertical = y reversed, rotational180 = both). mapinfo.cc:84-86 flips x unless vertical and y unless horizontal, which is right for all three. msy_before (mapinfo.h:178-184) uses the same axis logic, and the anchor rounding (mapinfo.cc:62-67) is consistent on the unflipped axis. A non-rectangular spawn falls back to each spawn's own centroid (:109-113), so nothing is assumed. No other mirror or reflection computation exists in src (grep: w-1-, h-1-, reflect_*).

## 2026-11-11T04:43Z C131 CTG2 spec review for Deep (v734; spec_ctg2_1111)
- Q1 YES, a CONFIRMED bug (MINOR->MAJOR by firing; Deep's stuckidle data): support_turn (econ_tank_support.cc:962-966) ignores cheap_camp_hit's bool and returns true. cheap_camp_hit's own comment (econ_capture.cc:898) says 'no hit: the camp turn runs after all', and the other caller (econ_target_turn.cc:492) honours it. A body out of reach of every group camp idles the turn.
- Q2 YES: ctg_rate_hi decays only in ~CtgMeter (:943), which exists only on the full path. Once one heavy turn inflates it, every gated turn skips the meter, so the gate can latch indefinitely (stuck idle).
- Q3 the fix is safe as long as the step is cheap: on the gated branch, (a) always decay: ctg_rate_hi -= ctg_rate_hi >> 5; (b) if (cheap_camp_hit(gi)) return true; else take ONE greedy step toward camp T.focus via try_move to the free neighbour that most reduces cheb (no step_to_set, which is the top many-group cut function; ~1-3k fuel, inside CTG_TAIL 16k), then return true. Flag-first (CTG2 bit). Count: gated turns with no hit, and latch length.

## 2026-11-11T09:34Z C155 SDH spec review for Deep (spec_sdh_1111, v743; inline)
- (1) YES. A stun stops a tribute even at timer 0, before the owner's next turn start, and the gems stay in the bag (INT:119-121, GR:226-232). A restart is a fresh max(1, ceil(bag_at_restart/10)) channel (ceil(0.67t) with the Tribute emblem), counted from the restart turn. So a later cancel denies strictly more channel time, PROVIDED it still lands before her turn start in the landing round (start round + ticks). If she gained gems meanwhile, the restart is longer still.
- (2) my_eta + 3 is SAFE but conservative. The exact last chance is any of our turns before her turn start in round land = start + ticks; in that round we act first only on our parity. The pending-at-zero rule gives no extra turn after her start. dlk_hold's 'left' (gd_mem.until) already adds +1 when the foe has acted this round (RGS bit 8, combat_deny.cc:736), so release when left <= my_eta + 1 is exact; +3 leaves 2 rounds for a refused cast, a cooldown slip or path noise. Keep +2 minimum. Also release at once if the stunner's HP or path is threatened (a dead stunner cancels nothing).
- (3) Hook: a sibling of dlk_hold (combat_deny.cc:641), using the same left/alt/stunnable inputs, in the stun-way branch before the stun is cast. It must not run when a lock is available (the lock cancels at once, no wait needed) or when another mate would stun first (game_deny_mates_ahead).

The budget rule is right only as: (sum over awake camps targeting it of camp str) + foe two-turn burst < current max HP. Death between heals loses the bag (GR:375). 'One turn's incoming' must include all camps targeting it and the foe double turn.
- (2) Hitting a monolith from a spawn tile: basic attack range 1 melee / 3 ranged (GR:118); targeted spells 'Enemy or camp · 4' (GR:452/458/570/600/670/702/758); ground areas 4 (+radius) or 2 (GR:482/506/544/576/606...). So it is reachable only if cheb(spawn tile, monolith) <= the kit's range (4 for most casters, 3 ranged basic, 1 melee). A monolith (range 5, GR:209) attacks the NEAREST champion, ours or the foe's (GR:192), not necessarily the spawn body; if a mate stands nearer, that mate is hit. Ties are not specified by the rules, so treat them as either.
- (3) Hook points not traced here (agents busy with the v753 review); Deep should confirm team_feasible_refresh (econ_rate.cc:358-383) and recruit (econ_rate_crew.cc:178) read the spawn-holder budget only for groups whose camps can reach a spawn tile.

## 2026-11-11T13:11Z C223 RKT (b1870 rkt on nova_base_v753, RKT_BITS=2): CORRECT. econ_tank_support.cc:264: the live bail term stays first; bit 2 adds eff_now < inc_now*rtk + keep (the rules-gaps:375 form), flag read before the term. rtk = hp_left/max(30,*dps) from the crew's dps BEFORE this loop's drops = the kill time if every counted mate holds. That is the right single-pass reading: recomputing after drops would lengthen rtk and cascade more bails (it needs a fixed-point loop, not worth it). ## 2026-11-11T13:12Z C222 VOC1 (b1871 voc, VOC_BITS=1): NOT CORRECT (/data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c222_voc.md)
- HOF1 MAJOR: hold_off (champ_vesper.cc ~:222) runs at the top of capture() (econ_capture.cc:682) every turn, including during a capture in progress (econ_target_turn.cc:529-531). A lone member walks off when Vesper is within 12 but not yet on the region, so the region is empty and the capture resets (GR:198/207); mark_mate_capture also marks the group respawning. Fix: if (on_group_spawn_tile(g, W.me.pos) && !on_group_spawn_tile(g, a.pos)) return false (same as the Willow/CI2 yields).
- HOF1b: no foe check, so holding off hands an uncontested capture to a foe near the region. Fix: return false with a foe near the region.
- RKE1 MINOR: the chain term keeps -5000 all game (as VOE1/C207 #6).
- VOE conflict: git merge-file gives one conflict in rank. Merged body: if (slot != carrier) return 0; end = now() > VOP_TAB[7]; if (gi == v) return (VOE_ON(1) && end) ? 0 : -5000; if (VOC_ON(1) && in_chain(gi)) return (end && !VOC_ON(2)) ? 0 : -5000; return 0. The second to ship rebuilds with it.
- Clean: flag 0, chain inputs (1.25 x cheb; [PATH] walls between anchors are MINOR), VOP_END under bit 1, fuel.

## 2026-11-11T13:14Z C225 CHZ 4+8 rework (b1853 chzo3, CHZ_BITS=12): CORRECT. cand is never reordered or swapped, so the PEC and targetless stored lists keep live's bound order (CHZ1/CHZ2 removed at the source). chz_rate is line-for-line the loop body (rate_for, ev/ev_any, linear_score::cand, the best update). Bit 4's three pre-rated groups are skipped in the loop right before rating, after the unchanged ub-break, so there is no double rating or double linear_score entry. A higher best_r only makes the ub-break fire earlier, which stays valid. Bit 8 rates once inside the floor block, then cuts as live; the group stays in the stored rest (re-rating next round is harmless). Flag 0: chz_pre {-1,-1,-1} and chz8 false. Cell code = low nibble FROM, high nibble TO (draft_memory.cc first_applicable_cell; draft_turn.cc:187/230): bit 1 ((MA|HR|VA)+1)<<4 | (VE+1) is VE -> MA/HR/VA, banded f9 >= OUT_LO; bit 2 ((VE+1)<<4)|(from+1) is FROM -> VE on f9 <= IN_HI. ## C740 TIR spec (Combat, spec_tir_1112) pre-arm review (RC, 2026-11-12T15:33Z): FIX-FIRST (2)
Defect by the rules is real: order within a team is priority then draft order (GR:129-130), so only a RANK change moves a foe's slot; a value re-draw at the same rank is a wasted worst case. TR1 (tie-break): the engine breaks priority ties by the lower body id, which is draft order (interactions.md:9/:16). "Roster order" must be the champion id or draft index, not W.enemies list order (built in perceive order). TR2 (visible-only rank): the true rank counts every foe on the team, including dead foes (GR:132: dead champions still act) and foes out of vision (priority reads rc 97, interactions.md:19). A visible-only rank can stay put while the true rank moves (an unseen mate re-draws across it), so tis returns 1 where live correctly returns 2: less safe than live, on the flee side. Fix: use the rank only when every living foe of that team is visible this round with a fresh q.pb and none is dead; otherwise keep live's value-change test. An unseen mate entering vision can only flip the rank and give an extra 2 (conservative, fine). Rows as specced; add the share of tis calls where the fallback applied.

## C744 MGC spec (RC, 2026-11-12T16:18Z): FIX-FIRST
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c744_mgc.md. (a) T_without is the claimant crew clear time as the bot sees it (claims_for_me excludes me; extra/recruit 0), caveat: T_with uses size_crew, so free mates joining count as my gain. (b) UNITS MISMATCH, blocks: rf_time includes walk, respawn wait, capture overhead, gather and the altar walk; T_without is bare clear time; gain is biased negative where claimants can clear, and becomes the unpenalised rate (x2 = a 2/pen boost) on contested/deep groups where they can't (likely much of the 2.56/g; the shadow did not log it). (c) linear_score::pick ranks post-opening choices on its own score, not r: a boosted r only raises lambda for all; the shadow logged best_r before pick(), so 2.56/g is not the pick-change count; the bound under-fires but is never wrong. Fixes: 1 require r > 0 (at r = -1 rf_* hold the previous candidate); 2 use the existing join_gain (same overheads both sides) x rf_pen; 3 keep r/best_r unboosted and scale rf_value by k around linear_score::cand only, after the opening; 4 apply the same helper in best_within and rate_cur (else the joined target loses its keep margin at the next retarget: cycling). Recommended: growth weight only when the claimant outranks me by cap_rank. Prefix free; fuel ~4-5 estimate_cx pairs/g; behaviour lane; prereg valid. Settling test if fix 3 is disputed: re-run the 150-game shadow logging the pick after pick() and claimant-alone feasibility.

## FRT1 foe_rank ties (RC, 2026-11-12T16:26Z): verified bug, bug bar
live combat_burst.cc:27-35 foe_rank counts a foe ahead only on a strictly higher value (pb[y] > pb[x]), so tied foes all get the lowest shared rank. The engine breaks priority ties by the lower body id, ids following draft order (interactions.md:9/:16). A tied foe that truly acts later is given an earlier rank: still_to_act (rb >= ra / rb > ra) can then read "already acted" for a foe still to act, under-predicting its turn this round (the unsafe direction for the reach/burst flees at combat_burst_reach.cc:344/:379/:408). Ties are common: priority defaults equal unless a team sets it. Fix (flag first): rb += pb[y] > pb[x] || (pb[y] == pb[x] && id[y] < id[x]) with id = champion id / draft index (not W.enemies order; same rule as TIR TR1); same for rb2. Check that ra/ra2 (our own rank) use the same tie rule, and the visible-only caveat (TIR TR2). Step 0: count assess calls where two visible foes tie on pb or pb2. Bug bar.

Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c753d_rdv.md. The arrival-block abandon test marks D abandoned if it is not CLEARED/RESPAWN on the first turn >= T, but T is when the crew meets and D clears after it (and a respawning D stops reading RESPAWN once its round passes, econ_observe.cc:111-113), so every episode ends abandoned with a 60-round cooldown and the tag-10 row reads ~100%. ## C808 DAWK1 b2325 diff (RC, 2026-11-12T18:35Z): CORRECT (fix --bugbar, DAWK_BITS=1)
dawk1.diff (v832). Bit 1: dash_away tests only the chosen landing (dawk_wakes = dash_mod > 0 && wakes_other_group(t, max(1, dash_radius), t, -1, 0), the same call as the other Heart dash sites). On a wake it re-picks via dawk_repick: up to 3 picks, a 3-entry skip list read inside dash_landing only while dawk_n > 0, with the same acceptance test (x >= 0 && dash_danger < now). With none left, it returns false and the flee falls through to its walk forms. pfa_dar_cast's re-picks after a refused landing are wake-tested too. Bounded at 3 SDK casts x 3 picks. dawk_n is reset on both exits and the calls don't nest, so the skip list can't leak. Bit 2 (deny landing, combat_deny.cc:271, after ++tries) is the same test; built, not in the flip. Flag first everywhere. Optional: at flag 0 dash_landing pays one volatile load per candidate for 'DAWK_ON(1) && dawk_n > 0'; dawk_n is nonzero only under the flag, so testing dawk_n first is identical and cheaper. Read the flag-0 same-work fuel row at prearm.

## C824 b2329 SFE bundle sfe4 on v833 (MWO1 + BFM1) (RC, 2026-11-12T19:07Z): BFM1 CORRECT; MWO1 FIX (final trip overcharged)
sfe4.diff. The multi-trip block (econ_clear_estimate.cc:173-190) runs only when one trip is infeasible (dmg > budget), with tmax = HE_TRIPS in play (OP_PLAY = 1 only in the opening sim, tmax 1 there). MWO1 lowers tb to budget - w (w = living str x (reach_max-1)) for EVERY trip, so tr = ceil(dmg / tb) also charges the FINAL trip, which ends in the capture with no walk-out (X720's form: "each trip except the last"). Fix: n trips absorb budget + (n-1)(budget - w), so tr = 1 + ceil((dmg - budget) / (budget - w)) when budget - w > 0, else infeasible; cyc += reach_max-1 only enters through (tr-1)*cyc (non-final trips: correct as built). ## C840 DAP holder after death (Shared Mem report on dap2) (RC, 2026-11-12T19:45Z): mitigated by live checks; hygiene fix only
Shared Mem: a dying holder never clears dap_hold or the field (dap_tick returns on !W.alive), and the tick's last line re-posts my slot when the field isn't me, so after death + takeover + respawn two bodies could both hold. RC trace (nova_b2311_dap2 econ_passage_hold.cc): the start gate (:421-423) refuses only while the posted holder is a DIFFERENT LIVING slot (siege_ally_alive), so a mate can take over from a dead holder; on respawn the old holder's first dap_tick sees hs = the taker, alive, and releases (the hs != me && siege_ally_alive(hs) branch) BEFORE the re-post line; with no taker it is at its spawn, and the far test (> 2 once arrived) releases it. So no lasting double hold. Remaining effect: during the ~60-round respawn the field still names the dead slot (harmless: readers check siege_ally_alive). Hygiene fix (optional, flag-gated): clear dap_hold and the field on the first dead turn. Process: Shared Mem's mechanical pre-arm check (new spare_alloc / extra_put id / mcl3/mcl4/late bit must cite teamword_bits.tsv or classbits.tsv) is added to the hunter brief and RC reviews.

## C786c DAP adaptation bit 32 (dap3 on v837) (RC, 2026-11-12T20:06Z): FIX-FIRST 1
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c786c_dap3.md. Fix (flicker): a foe counts as coming only if its walk to the cut fell between its last two sightings, so a visible foe standing still one round (attacking or waiting) reads as not coming and the hold releases at once with no cooldown: a foe that pauses or steps back and forth flips the hold, the shared holder post and mates' busy flag every round, and releases the holder just as the foe stops at the cut to fight. Latch the approach: record the round the walk last fell and keep the foe as coming for 10 rounds after while it stays on their side within 12 (inside the spec's "remembered within ~10 rounds"); add a start/release cycles-per-game counter. Correct otherwise: a single adaptation (the P.n == 3 skip is in the pre-stated text, spec :106; report rows by team size as info; run the 100x2 release diag before the class read); per-body foe data (only the body that sees the foe can start: expect few holds); age and side tests sound (<= 10 rounds stale); the field is built once per body behind 70k (camps passable: a minor distance error; optional: run the bit-32 test after the cheaper kit/HP/bag gates); the rebase order with PDK's pdk_turn is fine; flag first; no new shared-memory bits. Prearm must show flag-0 identity 40/40 (none on file).

Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c875_chw.md.

5. Rec: release the idle off-region mate the way the Prism wait does, or add an idle-rounds harm row.

## C883 CLT spec v2 (CLT_BITS=7) (RC, 2026-11-12T21:12Z): FIX-FIRST (9 edits)
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/c883_clt.md.
- Rules: a cleared group nobody stands on never respawns until captured, and waits with no timer (GR:196/:202). Any ally can capture it later; so can a foe, who is paid in full. Arriving on a foe-held region contests and resets it, which denies the foe but never wins the reward back. A body off the region is not paid.   3. The mark is the carry's own claim (no team-word bits). The leaver must not call mark_mate_capture. The fallback fires when she is late, drops her claim, dies (siege_ally_alive), turns to fight/flee/recall, or a foe comes within 8.
  4. Marcella only on gem-only groups.
  5. Keep bit 2's rate out of best_within (the C865b B2 class).
  6. Never arm with CHW, TAP or LJF bits 1/8; LJF must exempt the bit 4 trail target. Use the prefix CLTF_.
- Bit 4's trail rule is sound. Behaviour lane.
- C883 note (2026-11-12T21:12Z): edit 4 (Marcella gem-only) is overtaken by the owner's roster ruling (hunter_brief_p5.md 'Carry roster'): with Prism, Marcella takes gold-led groups; alone, she is the full carry. Marcella + Vesper is pending.

## X762 fuel: FSQ1 suspend cost (v840 profile; v842 lines) (RC, 2026-11-12T21:36Z)
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/x762_fsq.md. Estimates from cut-pairing; no body ids in the profile.
- FSQ1 skips the pause at econ_choose_target.cc:118/:1097. now() is frozen through the suspension (comment :16-17), so fsq_skip() stays true in the resumed tail, and the tail runs on into further cuts. That is ~2.1 cuts per FSQ choice.
- Per hms seat-game: ~196 FSQ choices, 282 loop cuts, then +86 loop / +138 sort cuts the next turn and +34 two turns later. So ~420 lost fresh turns (RSTL1) and ~400 no-action body-rounds. The pick is made on a view 1-2 rounds old.
- FQTL1 (MAJOR est.; behaviour, rare w_hms): skip once per suspension, not per round. Store fsq_f=fuel() at the skip; once fuel() > fsq_f (a fresh tail), pause normally. One cut per choice, with or without RSTL. Second arm: a lower pause floor with no suspend. Fallback: FSQ off above N groups. All are identical at unlimited fuel (cxeident proves nothing); they change play at 100k on hms. KILL: played < .50, or a Step 0 count of tail run-ons = 0.
- SPCH1 (possible): 4 cuts in a row before any action let the end-of-turn spin finish as a real recall. FSQ chains reach 3.
- FQCK1 (possible, minor): fsq_r stays set after a choice that ends with no pick, so later choices get no FSQ until the body has a target.
- FSQ is the only deliberate suspend (FG_TAIL ends the turn voluntarily; sps_* is clean).

## X778 fuel absorption mechanism (RC, 2026-11-12T22:43Z): the cuts-per-1k model is RETIRED
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/x778_absorption.md.
- On hms the turn is a chain of floor-run loops (bounds 30k, rating 32k, background 40k/34k) with big unchecked steps between them: compute_travel ~43k; the sort at econ_choose_target.cc:1075 (15k mean, 48-57k at 345 entries); the static table. A cut happens when an unchecked step starts below its cost, and fuel at that point is set by the previous loop's floor, not by earlier work.
- Freed fuel goes into: more choices opening (econ_retarget.cc:175 52k; :184 fg_pre + 15k; stick, formation, post-capture slices); loops finishing, after which the sort (only checked at 30k, :1097) cuts; re-due work next round; earlier background finishing. The extra choice let through is always the one with the least fuel left.
- Failures explained:
  - CTP1/TVH1/SXH1: a lower fg_pre meter opened :184, so more sorts started near 30k; cuts rose 357 v 312 (z +2.4) on BIG2, and 294.6 to 301.0 on hms.
  - LZI: the cut fall was real, but it removed an accidental ~28-turn hold on re-choices.
  - PSX: no-picks went 58 -> 276.
  - GFD: removed cuts weren't where games were lost.
- RIGHT SHAPE: cut or price the expensive step AT the site (a size-priced pause before the sort, TVC1, LZI); hold the re-choice gate on purpose (FGP1/GBX1, YGD1); cap the absorbing loop; or move work out of the turn.
- Pending lines:
  - not absorbed: FQTL, rstl3 (its 20k floor caps it), lzics, TVC1;
  - absorbed: TGDM1, SXMR1, OVSC1, RXLS1 (their 8-12 cuts/g does not hold), BBFX1 (PSX risk). IBMC1 is dropped.
- New model: count cuts avoided only when nothing gates between the saving and the cut site, at ~1.3 cuts per 1k. Otherwise quote 'fuel saved, cut change unknown, play changes'. Measure with a burn probe (a fixed 1-3k spin at the site, live, 40 w_hms x2).

## X787 STEP-DURING-CHOICE design check (WOC1 + SBRC1 merged; v845) (RC, 2026-11-12T23:28Z): FIX-FIRST (prefix SDCH)
Report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/x787_stepchoice.md. Estimates only.
- As written (step, then choose) it gains ~0. A cut turn resumes next round on the OLD round's state with no re-read (brain_modes.cc:4-12), so R+1 thinks it already moved: the move just shifts from R+1 to R, and switches pay a reversal (net <= 0).
- The gain needs a resumed-turn re-read: when round_number_nc() != W.round, clear moved and re-perceive so the post-choice step runs. RC NOTE: that is RSTL3's mechanism (C870b: it re-runs play on the new round; its diag showed R+1 acting .380 v .317, evidence the engine accepts moves in the resumed round). So SDCH should be built ON TOP of RSTL3, not as its own resumed-turn hack.
- Where: just before refresh_target inside !sg_hold (econ_target_turn.cc:468). Not when a paused bounds pass can resume (a step forces a 45-130k restart); not when a staged list is pending and the body moved (likely C928's .42/g 'moved' losses); never a dash.
- A possible existing gap: a walking body pauses its bounds pass and then steps that turn, so the pass always restarts next round (candidate bit 4).
- Gain ~0 to +22 body-rounds/hms seat-g (74 episodes/g). Needs CUV1 rows (a)-(f) first. Read after DSO1/lzics. Rare w_hms 420 with fresh no-harm rows.

## C940 CCQ (b2347 ccq.diff, v846; spec_ccq_1112) (RC inline, 2026-11-12T23:39Z): FIX
late_factors' `crew` is size_crew's SMALLEST feasible crew (econ_rate_crew.cc:270-283 breaks at the first feasible k; recruit only at crew==0), not the free bodies available. Bit 1 (crew < ccq_n_req) therefore refuses a group one body can clear even with free mates: avoidance, not 'go in force'. Fix: when the bit fires, size the crew up (crew_for_ref/estimate_cx from k = max(crew, n_req), or the living count for bit 2) and refuse only when fewer free bodies exist. ## X838 step refusals: freezes and oscillation, v862 (RC hunter, 2026-11-13T03:48Z), report /data/zw4424/rulecheck/p6/x838_freeze.md
try_move guards: foe_guarded is modelled by the field walkers (avoid_bb in step_to_set walls + step_open); SPZ, EOX and the bush hold are not (refused under the planner). sph_pin dead on v862 (combat_fight_turn.cc:469). 38 try_move + 81 step_* sites classed (x838/); most one-shots return false and fall through.
- XFZ1 MINOR [PATH] (bug bar bundle, < .02/g): combat_deny.cc:779-781 dlk_hold picks its danger-lowering side step with free_tile only, then try_move + return true; a foe_guarded (lethal-zone) refusal keeps the body on the deadlier tile every hold turn. Fix: pick with !mv::foe_guarded(t) too.
- XFZ2 MINOR [PATH] (bug bar bundle, Issac only, < .02/g): champ_ci.cc:221-233 takes the FIRST free range-4 tile (break) and one try_move; a refusal (SPZ in fight scope, lethal-zone guard) returns 1 = hold without trying the other range-4 tiles, same state next turn. Fix: try_move inside the loop.
- XFZ3 POSSIBLE [PATH] (behaviour; MAJOR if >= .3/g; count first): EOX keep_out_of_escaped_reach (econ_idle.cc:732-741) refuses reach steps for 8 rounds and exempts only an ENGAGED awake target; approach_group's guard (econ_approach.cc:184-185) is 5 rounds (hard-coded, not EO_ROUNDS) and off for an awake target. Awake-but-not-engaged target, or rounds 6-8: step_field/step_to plan into the reach, EOX refuses under them -> slide along the edge or stand up to 8 turns, then walk in, idle escape (brain_turn.cc:739-745) re-stamps: ~9-10 round cycle bounded by SD_TURNS 40. Fix: one rule for both (exempt group_awake(T.target), EO_ROUNDS window), or put EOX tiles in avoid_bb so the planner routes round them.
- XFZ4 POSSIBLE info [PATH]: SPZ form B refusal sits under fight_walk_in's planner: sidesteps that keep spawn distance, else fight false -> scope cleared -> econ walk may step closer to their spawn the same turn (C950c F2 by design). Count before a spec.
- XFZ5 CONFIRMED MINOR [PATH] (bug bar bundle, < .05/g): GR:165 bush refusal -> bsh hold blocks every later step (move_step.cc:54) until bush_hold_turn; CALM and low-fuel branches retry only bhw_resume's two 45-degree tiles (combat_fight_turn.cc:354-366), and an AfBail after the refusal skips turn_tail (brain_play.cc:200-212) so the allowance is lost. Fix: CALM re-runs the goal step once (or move_best over free non-worsening neighbours).
- (d) no new unbounded wait beyond X816 W1-W3. Diag spec (reason-coded no-move runs >= 3, A-B-A with the between-turn reason) in the report.

## LBC1 lethal burst v a spell off cooldown between two foe turns (Econ question, game 01a1d2bc W3 r803) (RC inline, 2026-11-13T08:43:48Z): POSSIBLE, count first.
Timing (GR:262 8-turn-end cooldown; INT:168 -1 per own turn end; GR:36 the starting team alternates each round): the foe Marcella cast at r795, so her cd reads 0 only after her r802 turn end. foe_ready(e, s, cdh) tests cd <= cdh; lethal_burst_hit is called with cdh 0 (combat_assess_rules.cc:600, combat_burst_reach.cc:36/71), so it prices spells ready NOW. That is exact for a foe with ONE turn before my next turn. A foe that acts AFTER me this round and FIRST next round (two turns before my next turn: the alternating start makes this common) casts on its second turn with cd_now <= 1: only combat_burst_reach.cc:49 adds a second hit with cdh 1, and only for the walk-then-hit reach composition (a foe that must close in). An in-range foe with two turns gets one hit priced with cd ready now -> the spell coming off cooldown between its two turns is missed. That fits W3: at r802 a cd of 1 is invisible to cdh 0. Fix form (fix lane / bug bar): in the lethal test, for a foe whose acting-order nn == 2 (build_acting_order_table / foe_turn_counts), add its second turn's hit priced with cdh 1. Count: assess turns where some foe has nn == 2, cd == 1 on a damage spell, and that hit would cross the lethal cap. Confirm on the W3 puppet at r802 (L's turn order, foe cd, a.stance).

Fix: on a non-Prism gate Again set T.bank_until = 0, and use `if (bank()) return true;` with fall-through to the filler/respawn_stage plus a short refusal stamp; or test tribute_start_allowed && !new_tribute_blocked before :279.

## C1199 DBU bit 32 ruling (Shared Mem, spec_dbu_1113.md 'Second count'; 2026-11-13T09:22:23Z; live v884)
- Premise INCORRECT: the order model already reads a seen acted foe's next-round priority. build_acting_order_table (combat_assess_contact.cc:266-298) fills pb2 = ed_prio_hdt(h, true) = champion_priority_of(h, 1) (combat_burst_reach.cc:246-253) = priority(), the next-round value for an acted foe (INT:18-21, b2300 50,306/50,306). There is no deliberate worst-case for acted foes in foe_turns_within_rounds (:300-325); the over-count (HAT) is the separate R table (rules-gaps 'Load-bearing model gaps').
- Likely cause of the count-1 misses (code reading, to be counted): the interleave index (INT:14-17: bodies alternate one at a time, each team sorted by priority then id, dead bodies keep their place) needs every body of BOTH teams, but ra/ra2 and rb/rb2 rank only bodies whose read_ci succeeds (W.allies / W.enemies, world.cc:381-391: unseen and dead bodies are skipped; their priorities are rc 97 anyway, INT:21). An unseen or dead foe ahead of e is dropped, e's rank falls, and e looks as if it acts first next round; an unseen mate ahead of me is dropped the other way (me earlier). Count to confirm: on the b2392 misses, foes on the roster that are not in W.enemies (alive unseen + dead) v mates likewise.
- So bit 32 'computed from the rules' cannot be exact for whole rosters: unseen priorities are unreadable. Legal forms: (a) EXACT-SAFE: 'known double' only when it holds for any unseen priorities: e's true rank >= its visible rank (lower bound holds), and every mate not in W.allies (unseen or dead) counted as ahead of me; (b) ESTIMATE: rank over the full rosters (ally_h / enemy_h), unseen bodies at their last-seen priority (else id tie); not exact, so a played read on the behaviour lane, not the bug bar.
- Bit 32 stays play-identical only as its own function for DBU's reads; replacing foe_turns_within_rounds changes channel_safe_check, tribute_stop_possible and rgf_foe_lock_in_time (combat_recall.cc:56/124/232) = behaviour lane. Do not tighten the HAT R table alone (load-bearing).
- C1195b (2026-11-13T09:23:47Z, b2394 nova_b2394_esw884 on v884): FIX CORRECT. esw_refuse (move_step.cc:69-81) refuses only new exposure (dd <= e.range and (dm > e.range or dd < dm)); the flag is read first at try_move :95 and brain_turn.cc:875/878; esw_r is set only for the farm stage and cleared after it. Flag 0 = v884. Notes: (1) e.range has no dash term, so a dasher's reach is under-counted (stated in the prereg; this is the permissive side). (2) It is not Prism-gated, and the shadow fires for every kit (fresh 0.85/g in 36/300 games, 12%; spawn-gap <= 10 class 161/300). ## C1202 ECW: recruit branch reach (Builder/Planner ask; live v887; 2026-11-13T09:59:05Z)
- BY DESIGN, not a defect. recruit() (econ_rate_crew.cc:298-333 on v887; :334 on v876) runs after size_crew (econ_rate.cc:421-422). It opens only when crew == 0 && !dg and one of three gates holds:
  - (a) siege: siege_map() && siege_group(g) && (n_att == 1 || sax_siege_ok) && siege_allowed (map-type gated);
  - (b) gem need: gn && gem_need_allowed. gn needs gn_band[gi], written by econ_comms_fields.cc:76/106, and gem_need() >= GN_CREW_MIN 0.5. gem_need_allowed admits only the designated or claimed band group;
  - (c) idle recruit: idle_recruit_open (econ_rate_contest.cc:213). That needs no target (or the ir_tgt target), contest <= .6, and a due IR_WAIT cadence round with fuel >= IR_FUEL_MIN.
- Every gate has a live writer and a reachable state. 0 entries in 386 choices means that sample had no siege map, gem need below .5 or a non-band group, and bodies with targets. It does not mean an impossible condition. Not a bug-bar line.
- For ECW bit 1: it widens size_crew's mate count. Once that finds a feasible crew, crew > 0 and recruit() is skipped, so the two cannot both add bodies. Keep ECW's far mates out of crew_for_ref's free count for the recruit loop's nfree (top - others - 1). Otherwise a far-called crew that is still infeasible would feed a larger nfree into the siege/gem-need recruit loop.

## C1203 GPL P1 design review (b2392 nova_b2392_gpl on v887; Builder relay; 2026-11-13T10:04:20Z)
- Identity at the live plan: CORRECT. f = 100/100 x 100/100 = 1.0f exactly, and the race term is skipped at strength 0 (no exp). gv x 1.0f == gv in IEEE arithmetic, so value and bound rows are byte-identical. The build is O(ng) once, static map data, no map identity.
- F1 FIX (shared-input rule, C1076/C980): the factor is applied only to the SELF row (self == my_slot()). rate_for rows for mates (the team model: crew, claims, joins) stay unweighted, while each mate weights its own row. My model of a mate then disagrees with what the mate does whenever a weight != 100. The factor depends only on gi, static map data and now(), which every body shares. Apply it to every row (drop self == my_slot()) at both value sites and both bound copies.
- F2 FIX (bound soundness): the bound copies return gv x f, but some rows are left unweighted: finish_group_value (ro4_fin and the pair finish_progress_mode branch) and PEG1's xgv_gold_value/2 override. For f < 1, the bound can fall below the unweighted value and prune a group that would win. Either use gv x max(1, f) in the bound copies, or weight those rows too. State which form in the prereg. Unless endgame_bound already covers these rows: then say so in the prereg with its line.
- NOTES: go-time default GPL_TAB[3] = 2000 = game end (GR, 'bank by 2000'), so the post weights never apply; an arm must set T < 2000. Empty groups (0 gold, 0 gems) class as gold-led (0 <= 0). pty_rate (MGY) and other group_value readers stay unweighted; that is fine for P1, but say so.

## C1204 WFH pre-build confirmations (b2363, spec_wfh_1113; Builder relay; 2026-11-13T10:05:54Z)
- (1) Same-turn vision: CONFIRMED, with caveats. INT:194: a ward placed this turn updates occupancy within the turn (184/262). INT:193: ward-then-cast happens in one turn. The order must be ward -> re-perceive -> landing tests -> cast: once the crystal channel starts, every action fails (rc 123, INT:143; GR:118). Caveats:
  - (a) The crystal is a 3-turn channel (GR:329). The landing resolves 3 turns later, can't be cancelled (INT:143), and a foe stun cancels it and loses the crystal (INT:144; not Marcella's). So the landing tests must price foe reach over the channel, not only who stands near the tile now. The ward's main gain is seeing the approach.
  - (b) The re-perceive bumps pstamp. Memos keyed on round only, like build_acting_order_table's hdt_o (round + body, C1199), will not include newly revealed foes: lookups by h return 'not in sight'. Check every memo the landing tests read, or rebuild them after the re-perceive.
  - (c) Price the re-perceive's fuel into the step's floor (the ESCF2 pattern), so the ward can't be placed and then the cast cut.
- (2) Ward-tile legality: CONFIRMED.
  - Chebyshev <= 2 (GR:106).
  - Refused: wall/hole/altar/enemy spawn (rc 64) and a mate's ward tile (rc 117) (INT:192, INT:195). No line of sight needed (INT:193). An enemy ward's tile and a bush tile holding an unseen foe are allowed (INT:161, INT:195).
  - Needs the charge (10 owner turn ends, GR:106, GR:118); placing moves the body's one ward.
  - Refused when stunned (rc 63, INT:43), during a channel, and when dead (INT:163).
  - Extra: moving the ward drops vision at its old tile. List the consumers of the old ward's sight (bank or altar watch, ward-seen camps INT:106, ward_bush placements) and skip WFH when the old ward guards something those consumers use this turn or next.

## C1205 DBU bit 2 precedence (b2393, v887; 2026-11-13T10:07:44Z)
- (1) 'want > cur_prio' is the right reading of 'the jump'. Higher priority acts first (INT:14-15), and set_priority takes effect next round (GR 'Who goes first'), so raising want now moves the next-round slot earlier: late now, first next = the double. Do NOT block the hp_order_tier DROP: that makes a hurt body act LATER, which is the 'keeps a late slot' the spec wants. Doubles from team alternation alone (equal ranks, no priority change) are outside bit 2 by the spec's wording ('live's own priority drop / jump'); say so in the prereg.
- Build form:
  - Apply the gate LAST, after Issac's tie order (ci2::issac_order / issac_tie), else Issac's adjustment can raise it again.
  - Mark the overrides with bools set in their branches (finish35 / lethal40), not by comparing want to 35/40, because base = P.prio[slot] - 7 x fq can equal those values.
  - Skip the gate when !W.alive.
- (2) Precedence as written is CORRECT: both overrides sit inside the camp_threat <= 0 block and win over bit 2. The PHY hold (cur_prio == 40 -> phy_lethal_at) is unchanged. Note: the DBU 'double' counts read the visible-only order model (C1199).

- (a) The claim is NOT a faithful call. My crew pick (named mates, chosen from my sight and their claims) is never sent. Without a field, the keep needs a CONVERGENCE exit: after the slowest counted walk + 5 rounds, if claimants of gi on the shared claims are < the crew counted - 1, end the keep (and set fail_until so it doesn't re-pick at once).

  - Recall: the keep holds through a recall channel. Fine, since the retarget only returns early.
- (c) The value proxy (their claimed group's group_value x 3 < this one) ignores the mate's walk and clear time, so it can pull a mate off a near, quick, high-rate job. Acceptable as a proxy; state it. Mates' own rate_for does not run the far call (self row only); that is right, since its inputs are own sight, but the team model then won't predict ECW picks.
- (d) Unseen mates: ally reads out of sight return rc 97 (INT:21; 96% of unseen-alive turns), so HP, channel and bag are unknown, not 0 or 'fine'. Unseen mates pass the HP and channel tests by default. Exclude unseen mates whose claim shows a bank, tribute or recall walk, if published. Death is readable out of sight (sdk_champion_is_alive rc 0), so check it. Use the claim anchor only when the claim is this round's.
- Value: with bit 2, value x sqrt(crew) / crew stacks with crew_bonus (1/(1 - CREW_PAIR x ke) for 2+ crews), giving double crew credit. State which is intended, or skip crew_bonus for ecw_k > 0 under bit 2.

## C1212 CMV N1c bit 2 (b2384 nova_b2384_n1c on v887; 2026-11-13T10:10:38Z)
- FIX (streak cap broken): publish() runs several times per turn (publish_task at brain_turn.cc:8, :770, :803 and brain_play.cc:179). cmvc_keep resets the streak to 1 whenever cmvc_last_r != W.round - 1, so on a second call in the same round (last_r == round) the streak returns to 1. It then reads 2 at most at the next round's first call, the cap (c) '<= 2 consecutive rounds' never trips, and the keep can last the whole stance blackout while (a) and (b) hold. Fix: decide once per round. Keep (streak, keep, eng_g) from the round's first call and reuse it on later calls in the same round (if cmvc_last_r == W.round, return the round's stored keep for the same group). Advance the streak only when the previous stance round was W.round - 1. Recount Step 0 after the fix: the current 18.5 turns/g may include over-cap rounds.
- The rest is CORRECT: own published state only; retreat (flv/4 == 2) and coming codes untouched; engaged claim per C1188; the camp-tile proximity uses group member camp tiles.
